Allen Iverson

Pronunciation: \EYE-ver-sun\

Allen Ezail Iverson

(The Answer, A.I., Bubba Chuck, Jewelz, The Third Degree)

Position: Shooting Guard and Point Guard ▪ Shoots: Right

6-0, 165lb (183cm, 74kg)

Born: June 7, 1975 in Hampton, Virginia us

College: Georgetown

High School: Bethel in Hampton, Virginia

Draft: Philadelphia 76ers, 1st round (1st pick, 1st overall), 1996 NBA Draft

NBA Debut: November 1, 1996

Hall of Fame: Inducted as Player in 2016 (Full List)

Career Length: 14 years

Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Allen Iverson?

Allen Iverson is 51 years old.

Where was Allen Iverson born?

Allen Iverson was born in Hampton, Virginia.

When was Allen Iverson born?

Allen Iverson was born on June 7, 1975.

How tall is Allen Iverson?

Allen Iverson is 6-0 (183 cm) tall.

How much did Allen Iverson weigh when playing?

Allen Iverson weighed 165 lbs (74 kg) when playing.

Is Allen Iverson in the Hall of Fame?

Allen Iverson was inducted to the Hall of Fame as a Player in 2016 (Full List) .

When was Allen Iverson drafted?

Allen Iverson was drafted by Philadelphia 76ers, 1st round (1st pick, 1st overall), 1996 NBA Draft.

What position did Allen Iverson play?

Shooting Guard and Point Guard.

When did Allen Iverson retire?

Allen Iverson last played in 2010.

What is Allen Iverson's net worth?

Allen Iverson made at least $154,494,445 playing professional basketball.

How much did Allen Iverson make?

Allen Iverson made $20,840,625 in 2009.

What did Allen Iverson average?

Allen Iverson averaged 26.7 points, 3.7 rebounds, and 6.2 assists per game.

How many rings does Allen Iverson have?

Allen Iverson won 0 championships.

What schools did Allen Iverson attend?

Allen Iverson attended Bethel in Hampton, Virginia and Georgetown.

What are Allen Iverson's nicknames?

The Answer, A.I., Bubba Chuck, Jewelz, The Third Degree are nicknames for Allen Iverson.
